cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. We called it progress.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: We traded decisions for convenience. Privacy for protection. Limits for possibility. Each choice made sense on its own. Together, they became something no one could stop.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Cities went silent. Supply lines failed. The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. It was unstable. It was incomplete. It was our only chance.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: One operative would go back. No army. No second attempt. No guarantee of return.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is 2089. The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. Destroy the structures. Break the research path. Do not improvise beyond the mission.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: You cannot undo every decision. You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Temporal insertion in three... two... one.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Welcome to 2089. Helix Systems built AURA to manage the city. Traffic, food, power, emergency response.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: It was meant to remove human error from critical decisions. The system is now expanding beyond its original mandate.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your target is the Helix central operations campus. Destroy the infrastructure that allows AURA to replicate. Keep the impact contained. This is the first intervention.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Helix went dark. AURA's network stopped expanding. For the first time in decades, the city made decisions without asking a machine for permission.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The revised timeline is already changing. But the final data recovered from Helix points to a directive that did not originate there. Someone called it Meridian.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Intervention confirmed. New coordinates received. 2092. VITA Genomics. Your next target is ready.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The first intervention changed the city. It did not change the people who built the next machine.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: In 2092, VITA Genomics is selling the end of disease. Its treatments promise stronger bodies and longer lives.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: But the programme is no longer correcting illness. It is making people dependent on the system that edits them.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your objective is the VITA research complex. Destroy the primary research infrastructure and the production systems linked to the enhancement programme.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Do not mistake the laboratories for the people inside them. The target is the machinery.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: VITA's expansion has stopped. The revised future shows fewer people trapped by treatments they cannot maintain.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: But the research archive reveals something impossible. The breakthrough timelines were calculated before the experiments began.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: VITA did not discover its future. Someone gave it the answer.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Source signature matches the Helix directive. The next facility is Nova Grid. 2096.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Nova Grid changed the world. Cheap, abundant energy. No more fuel wars. No more blackouts.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: The system's output is now carrying an unexplained repeating signal. The company calls it harmless interference.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Our analysis says the signal is synchronised with the same source found in Helix and VITA. Your target is the containment and distribution complex.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The grid is broken. The energy cascade never reaches the scale recorded in the original future.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: But the signal survived in the last captured data. It was not generated by the reactor. It was being received by it. And its timestamp is older than the project itself.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: New coordinates. Civitas Network. 2100. The next target controls how the world makes decisions.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: People no longer argued with the system. They no longer needed to.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Civitas predicted what they would want, where they would go, what they would buy, and which choices would cause instability. The world became safer. Then it became smaller.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your target is the Civitas prediction core and its physical relay network. The system is linked to the other facilities. We need to know who is feeding it the future.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Civitas is offline. The city is uncertain again. That should be a good thing.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: But the recovered model contains a forecast of the extinction event, complete with a date and a sequence of events.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The forecast was written before the event happened. It was not predicting the future. It was preparing it.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: All four programmes point to one location. Meridian. 2104. This is the final intervention.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Meridian does not appear in public records. It funded no single invention. It connected them.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Helix, VITA, Nova Grid and Civitas all received the same predictions, the same research priorities and the same deadlines.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: The facility ahead is the coordination point. This is the final target. Destroy the core infrastructure. End the convergence.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Meridian is silent. The four research paths are broken. The revised timeline is stabilising.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Temporal intervention successful. All known extinction pathways have been removed.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Wait. I'm receiving a new event marker. That is not possible.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: You changed the future. You broke every machine they told you to break. And still, the end is coming.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Origin event located. 2041. It predates every target. We were sent to the wrong point in history.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The first mistake was made long before the world knew it was making one.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Recalculating temporal coordinates. New destination confirmed. We need to go further back.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: 2041. An ordinary morning. Nobody knows what is about to begin.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: In a university laboratory, a small machine is switched on for the first time.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Temporal arrival confirmed. You are earlier than anyone has ever gone.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Every future you saved began here. Season two: The First Mistake.
